zh.title: 美國航空客艙霧氣後緊急降落 乘客疏散至跑道
zh.summary: 美國航空客艙出現霧氣後緊急降落，乘客疏散至跑道。
body: Simple Flying報導標題稱，美國航空乘客在客艙出現霧氣後，緊急降落並疏散至跑道。標題描述客艙霧氣與緊急降落，並稱乘客撤離至跑道；但沒有提供航班、機型、機場或事發日期，因此無法據此辨識涉及的飛機或地點。
報導摘要另稱，起飛後不久氧氣面罩落下，部分乘客從機翼跳下。摘要沒有說明跳下機翼的乘客人數，也未交代霧氣原因或疏散後情況。現有描述僅能支持報導所述的面罩部署與乘客行動，不能據此判定事件原因或傷亡情況。

en.title: American Airlines passengers evacuate after cabin haze emergency landing
en.summary: American Airlines passengers evacuate onto a runway after an emergency landing amid cabin haze.
body: Simple Flying reports in its headline that American Airlines passengers evacuated onto a runway after an emergency landing associated with cabin haze. The headline describes the landing and runway evacuation but does not identify the flight, aircraft, airport or date of the occurrence, so those details cannot be specified here.

The accompanying summary says oxygen masks deployed shortly after takeoff and that some passengers jumped from the wing. It does not state how many people jumped, what caused the cabin haze or what happened after the evacuation. The available account supports those reported actions, but does not establish a cause for the haze or an injury outcome.

zh.title: 巴基斯坦延長對印度航空器空域禁令至11月24日
zh.summary: 巴基斯坦延長印度航空器空域禁令至2026年11月24日，並發布新航行通告。
body: 巴基斯坦將對印度航空器的空域禁令再延長一個月，限制維持至2026年11月24日。巴基斯坦機場管理局（Pakistan Airports Authority，PAA）已發布新的航行通告（NOTAM），把限制期限延至原定2026年10月24日到期日之後。
禁令適用於在印度註冊的航空器，以及由印度航空公司或營運業者擁有、營運或租賃的航空器，軍事航班也在適用範圍內；限制涵蓋巴基斯坦喀拉蚩與拉合爾飛航情報區。報導指出，空域限制已迫使印度航空公司的國際航班改道，延長措施維持既有禁令，而非新增限制；這項幹擾已持續超過一年。

en.title: Pakistan extends airspace ban on Indian airlines through November 24, 2026
en.summary: Pakistan extends its ban on Indian aircraft through November 24, 2026, under a new NOTAM.
body: Pakistan has extended its airspace ban on Indian aircraft for another month, keeping restrictions in place until November 24, 2026. The Pakistan Airports Authority issued a new Notice to Airmen (NOTAM) extending the restriction beyond its previous expiry date of October 24, 2026.

The ban covers Indian-registered aircraft and aircraft owned, operated or leased by Indian airlines and operators, including military flights, across Pakistan’s Karachi and Lahore flight information regions. The latest extension maintains an existing measure rather than adding a new restriction. The restrictions have forced Indian airlines to reroute international flights, and the disruption has continued for more than a year.

zh.title: 星宇航空布拉格直飛航線載客率達82% 10月增至每週4班
zh.summary: 星宇航空布拉格航線載客率達82%，10月起增為每週4班。
body: 星宇航空8月開航臺北－布拉格直飛航線，並自10月起將班次增至每週4班。星宇航空表示，航線開航後單月載客率為82%；報導並指出，進入11月歐洲旅遊淡季後，載客率仍維持在8成以上。
星宇航空公關長梁文龍表示，旺季客源主要為臺灣旅客前往布拉格，淡季則有捷克旅客赴臺、轉機前往日本的需求挹注。他看好布拉格直飛航線可串聯臺灣與捷克的觀光、企業投資及半導體供應鏈合作。

en.title: StarLux Prague Route Reports 82% Load Factor as Frequency Rises to Four Weekly
en.summary: StarLux Airlines says its Prague route reached 82% load factor and four weekly flights from October.
body: StarLux Airlines launched its nonstop Taipei–Prague route in August and increased service to four flights a week from October. The airline said the route recorded a monthly load factor of 82% after it opened. The report also said the load factor remained above 80% into the European low season in November.

StarLux public relations chief Liang Wen-lung said peak-season traffic came mainly from Taiwanese travelers heading to Prague. He said Czech travelers flying to Taiwan and connecting onward to Japan contributed during the low season. Liang also said the airline viewed the route as a way to connect tourism, business investment and semiconductor supply-chain cooperation between Taiwan and the Czech Republic.
